describe.seed: Locate the paper in OpenAlex by DOI / arXiv ID / title to fix the seed node. DOI is most precise; title is a last-resort fallback (may return a different version of a same-titled paper).
describe.references: Read the seed's referenced_works field to fetch "what this paper cites". Current scale: up to {{refs}} entries in OpenAlex order. Edge direction: seed → referenced paper.
describe.citedBy: Use filter=cites to look up "who cites this paper", sorted by citation count descending. Current scale: up to {{citedBy}} entries (the {{citedBy}} most influential follow-ups). Edge direction: citing → seed.
describe.hop2: Pick the top {{topN}} most-cited nodes from hop 1 as parents, expanding each by {{refsPer}} references + {{citedByPer}} cited_by to form 2-hop relations. Theoretical cap {{cap}} new nodes; fewer after de-duplication.

scalePreset.describe: Hop 1: {{refs}} refs + {{citedBy}} cited-by; Hop 2: top {{topN}} × ({{refsPer}}+{{citedByPer}}) ≤ {{cap}} nodes
